LanguageData.XTS_XenotypesSectionDesc: Tick the xenotypes traders may sell xenogerms for. Unticked xenotypes stay in the list, greyed, so the ones on sale stand out. The category rows above the list switch whole groups at once and show a partial mark while a group is mixed. A xenotype loaded for the first time starts out matching the majority of its group. Hover a xenotype for its description and price breakdown.
LanguageData.XTS_FilterArchiteDesc: Every preset xenotype containing archite genes (e.g., Sanguophage). These are typically more expensive. Custom xenotypes from your scenario are grouped under the scenario row instead, whatever genes they contain.
LanguageData.XTS_FilterInheritableDesc: Every preset xenotype whose xenogerm rewrites the pawn's germline: inheritable xenotypes (e.g., Impid, Yttakin), whose implanted members are 'naturalized' and recognized by ideology, and Baseliner, whose empty xenogerm converts the pawn back to a baseliner outright. Sold nowhere unless enabled.
LanguageData.XTS_FilterPlayerScenarioDesc: The custom xenotypes your scenario's starting colonists were created with, whatever genes they contain. Xenotypes assembled in-game at the gene assembler are never sold.
LanguageData.XTS_XenotypePlayerScenario: Defined in your scenario, not by a mod or DLC
LanguageData.XTS_CustomXenotypeDesc: A custom xenotype your scenario's starting colonists were created with.
LanguageData.XTS_PricingSectionDesc: Adjust the market value formula for trader-sold xenogerms. Changes affect new xenogerms only.
LanguageData.XTS_BasePresetValueDesc: Base silver value added to all preset xenotype xenogerms. Default: {0}
LanguageData.XTS_ValuePerMetabolismDesc: Silver value added per point of absolute metabolism. Default: {0}
LanguageData.XTS_ValuePerComplexityDesc: Silver value added per point of genetic complexity. Default: {0}
LanguageData.XTS_ValuePerArchiteDesc: Silver value added per archite gene. Default: {0}
LanguageData.XTS_QuantitySectionDesc: How many xenogerms each trader kind carries, rolled from the range for every new trader. Changes affect newly generated traders only.
LanguageData.XTS_TraderCountDesc: The number of xenogerms this trader arrives with, rolled from this range each visit. Default: {0}~{1}
LanguageData.XTS_ImplantationSectionDesc: How trader-sold xenogerms behave when implanted.
LanguageData.XTS_ImplantGermlineAsEndogenesDesc: When a trader-sold xenogerm for a germline xenotype is implanted, write its genes into the pawn's germline as endogenes instead of as xenogenes, replacing the previous germline genes (skin and hair colour are kept when the new xenotype doesn't set them). The pawn becomes a born member of that xenotype: children inherit the genes, and a later xenogerm implant adds to them instead of overwriting them. As with a born member, no xenogerm can be extracted from the pawn afterwards.
LanguageData.XTS_CommonalitySectionDesc: How a trader picks which xenotypes its xenogerms are for. Chances are recomputed from the prices of everything currently sellable, so the choice applies to newly generated stock only.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyInversePriceDesc: Cheaper xenogerms are more common: each xenotype's chance is proportional to 1 divided by its price. Expensive archite xenogerms stay rare finds.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategySoftInversePriceDesc: Cheaper xenogerms are still more common, but the bias is gentler: each xenotype's chance is proportional to 1 divided by the square root of its price.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyPriceDesc: Pricier xenogerms are more common: each xenotype's chance is proportional to its price.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategySqrtPriceDesc: Pricier xenogerms are still more common, but the bias is gentler: each xenotype's chance is proportional to the square root of its price.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyBellCurveDesc: Mid-priced xenogerms are the most common: chances follow a bell curve centred on the median price of everything sellable, so the cheapest and the priciest are both rare.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyUniformDesc: Every sellable xenotype is equally likely, regardless of price.
